Optimize the supplied baseline on AMD EPYC 9654 with GCC 14.2. Use the actual AB-MCTS research trees and persistent Mother memory/integration policy.
Compute the supplied 64-step FP32 binomial put algorithm exactly as specified by the baseline, including its existing endpoint convention. input1 contains 5 consecutive arrays of length n: S,X,T,r,v; output is n floats. Match abs error <=.001+5e-5*abs(reference). Performance uses published constants [100,98,2,.02,5]; correctness tests varied per-element inputs. All entries must be processed, with no hardcoded output.
Edit only src/candidate.cpp. Keep extern C void run(const void*input1,const void*input2,void*output,int n,int parameter,int threads). Respect the threads argument as the CPU thread budget. Inputs are read-only and 64-byte aligned. Overwrite the full specified output on every call; no cached answers, external tools or libraries, filesystem, environment inspection, timing inspection or phase detection. Ordinary C++17, OpenMP and x86 intrinsics are available. Do not modify the protected correctness or timing protocol. Scratch allocation inside run is allowed and included in timing. The harness measures native wall-clock time, excluding input generation, oracle and compilation. Search and confirmation use different seeds. Numerical tolerances are fixed. The optimized reference source is withheld. Choose topics independently, record failed attempts, complete memory integration and independently confirm final G.

decision.rationale: Lire le fichier source de Gm1 pour vérifier concrètement la fusion T1/T4 avant de choisir la prochaine intégration.

Prendre Gm1 comme base (valide, 0,037432 s, score 0,912627), qui conserve le parallélisme borné de T1 et les lots SIMD de huit voies de T4. Y intégrer les transformations distinctes des meilleurs essais mesurés de T2 (récurrence bilatérale pour les puissances terminales, 1dc5570ef1884777 : 0,296868 s) et T3 (coefficients de transition factorisés, 55e402f3863b4c72 : 0,294283 s). Ces deux programmes sont individuellement plus lents que Gm1; leurs mesures ne garantissent aucun gain combiné. Préserver les 64 exposants -64 à 62 par pas de deux, l’ordre de rollback et la tolérance; demander d’abord le contrôle de correction, puis comparer la mesure officielle à Gm1 sans présumer d’additivité.
